1.

This is a petition filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 0605/2020 dated 17.12.2020 registered at PS Mayur Vihar Phase-I under Section 406/498A/34 IPC.
2.
The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 13.02.2023 before the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre, wherein the parties have settled their disputes without any financials.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioners are present in Court through video conferencing mode and have been identified by Mr. Simon Benjamin, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court through video conferencing and has been identified Mr. Prashant Mendiratta, learned counsel who has also joined through video conferencing mode.
4. The respondent No.2 has been asked and states that she has agreed to settle the matter without any financials.
5. The parties state that they have arrived at the above said settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
6. There is no child born out of the wedlock.
